title: #410 Traditional Books
prompt: Do you agree that traditional books are better for learning than electronic books?

promptSegments.text: Do you agree that traditional books are better for learning than electronic books?

hardVocabulary.enGloss: A key word in this prompt.
A key word in this prompt.
A key word in this prompt.

requirements.en: State how far you agree or disagree.
requirements.vi: Nêu mức độ đồng ý hoặc không đồng ý.

requirements.en: Support your position with two clear reasons.
requirements.vi: Hỗ trợ quan điểm bằng hai lý do rõ ràng.

requirements.en: Use relevant examples when they strengthen an idea.
requirements.vi: Dùng ví dụ phù hợp khi chúng làm rõ ý.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Traditional books help students focus better because they keep the reader's attention on the page.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Traditional books help students focus better because they keep the reader's attention on the page.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Paper books are less distracting than digital screens, which helps students concentrate on their learning.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Paper books are less distracting than digital screens, which helps students concentrate on their learning.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Traditional books are good because they help people focus and concentrate on reading.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Traditional books are good because they help people focus and concentrate on reading.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Digital books are good because they are portable and can hold many subjects.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Digital books are good because they are portable and can hold many subjects.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Traditional books enhance learning through a physical, tactile connection, allowing readers to mark passages and improving memory retention compared to screen viewing.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Traditional books enhance learning through a physical, tactile connection, allowing readers to mark passages and improving memory retention compared to screen viewing.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Traditional books improve concentration by limiting digital distractions, unlike e-readers that often pull attention away with notifications or links.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Traditional books improve concentration by limiting digital distractions, unlike e-readers that often pull attention away with notifications or links.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Electronic books are more practical for students because they allow people to carry many books in one small device.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Electronic books are more practical for students because they allow people to carry many books in one small device.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Digital formats improve accessibility for many learners because e-books can adjust the text size and contrast for different needs.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Digital formats improve accessibility for many learners because e-books can adjust the text size and contrast for different needs.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not explain the statement without making your own position clear.
promptTraps.vi: Không chỉ giải thích nhận định mà quên nêu rõ quan điểm cá nhân.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.
